name: qutrit_block_four_products_to_bipartite
lines: B C : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ
v : Fin 4 → Fin 3 → ℂ
a b : Fin 4 → ℂ
hv : ∀ (t : Fin 4) (i : Fin 3), star (v t i) = v t i
h0 : 1 = ∑ t, (a t * star (a t)) • vecMulVec (v t) (star (v t))
hB : B = ∑ t, (a t * star (b t)) • vecMulVec (v t) (star (v t))
hC : C = ∑ t, (b t * star (b t)) • vecMulVec (v t) (star (v t))
⊢ ∀ (i j : Fin 3) (p q : Fin 2),
(if p = 0 then if q = 0 then 1 i j else B i j else if q = 0 then Bᴴ i j else C i j) =
∑ t, v t i * ![a t, b t] p * star (v t j * ![a t, b t] q)
i j : Fin 3
p q : Fin 2
⊢ (if p = 0 then if q = 0 then 1 i j else B i j else if q = 0 then Bᴴ i j else C i j) =
∑ t, v t i * ![a t, b t] p * star (v t j * ![a t, b t] q)
h0' : 1 i j = (∑ t, (a t * star (a t)) • vecMulVec (v t) (star (v t))) i j
hB' : B i j = (∑ t, (a t * star (b t)) • vecMulVec (v t) (star (v t))) i j
hC' : C i j = (∑ t, (b t * star (b t)) • vecMulVec (v t) (star (v t))) i j
hBt : B j i = (∑ t, (a t * star (b t)) • vecMulVec (v t) (star (v t))) j i
case «0»
q : Fin 2
⊢ (if (fun i => i) ⟨0, ⋯⟩ = 0 then if q = 0 then 1 i j else B i j else if q = 0 then Bᴴ i j else C i j) =
∑ t, v t i * ![a t, b t] ((fun i => i) ⟨0, ⋯⟩) * star (v t j * ![a t, b t] q)
case «1»
⊢ (if (fun i => i) ⟨1, ⋯⟩ = 0 then if q = 0 then 1 i j else B i j else if q = 0 then Bᴴ i j else C i j) =
∑ t, v t i * ![a t, b t] ((fun i => i) ⟨1, ⋯⟩) * star (v t j * ![a t, b t] q)
⊢ (if (fun i => i) ⟨0, ⋯⟩ = 0 then if (fun i => i) ⟨0, ⋯⟩ = 0 then 1 i j else B i j
else if (fun i => i) ⟨0, ⋯⟩ = 0 then Bᴴ i j else C i j) =
∑ t, v t i * ![a t, b t] ((fun i => i) ⟨0, ⋯⟩) * star (v t j * ![a t, b t] ((fun i => i) ⟨0, ⋯⟩))
⊢ (if (fun i => i) ⟨0, ⋯⟩ = 0 then if (fun i => i) ⟨1, ⋯⟩ = 0 then 1 i j else B i j
else if (fun i => i) ⟨1, ⋯⟩ = 0 then Bᴴ i j else C i j) =
∑ t, v t i * ![a t, b t] ((fun i => i) ⟨0, ⋯⟩) * star (v t j * ![a t, b t] ((fun i => i) ⟨1, ⋯⟩))
⊢ (if (fun i => i) ⟨1, ⋯⟩ = 0 then if (fun i => i) ⟨0, ⋯⟩ = 0 then 1 i j else B i j
∑ t, v t i * ![a t, b t] ((fun i => i) ⟨1, ⋯⟩) * star (v t j * ![a t, b t] ((fun i => i) ⟨0, ⋯⟩))
hBt' : star (B j i) = star ((∑ t, (a t * star (b t)) • vecMulVec (v t) (star (v t))) j i)
⊢ (if (fun i => i) ⟨1, ⋯⟩ = 0 then if (fun i => i) ⟨1, ⋯⟩ = 0 then 1 i j else B i j
∑ t, v t i * ![a t, b t] ((fun i => i) ⟨1, ⋯⟩) * star (v t j * ![a t, b t] ((fun i => i) ⟨1, ⋯⟩))

steps.tactic: have h0' := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ => M i j) h0
have hB' := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ => M i j) hB
have hC' := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ => M i j) hC
have hBt := congrArg (fun M : Matrix (Fin 3) (Fin 3) ℂ => M j i) hB

simpa [Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, hv, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm, mul_left_comm,
  mul_assoc] using h0'

simpa [Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, hv, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm, mul_left_comm,
  mul_assoc] using hB'

simpa [Matrix.conjTranspose_apply, Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, star_sum, hv,
  smul_eq_mul, mul_comm, mul_left_comm, mul_assoc] using hBt'

simpa [Matrix.sum_apply, Matrix.smul_apply, Matrix.vecMulVec_apply, hv, smul_eq_mul, mul_comm, mul_left_comm,
  mul_assoc] using hC'
